Mattermost.note: Inflect with a hyphen/colon only when unavoidable: 'Mattermostin', 'Mattermostissa' are fine as the name ends in a consonant.

Team Edition.note: Legacy catalog has 'Joukkuemuunnelma' / 'Yritysmuunnelma' in about.* — do not follow; edition names stay in English.

Mattermost Cloud.note: Legacy about.cloudEdition has 'Pilvi'; the product name stays in English.

Channels.note: As a product name keep English. The common noun 'channels' is 'kanavat'.

Calls.note: Product name stays English; the common noun 'call' is 'puhelu'.

LDAP.note: 'AD/LDAP' stays as-is; compound with a hyphen: 'AD/LDAP-käyttäjänimi'.

MFA.note: Spelled out, the catalog uses 'monivaiheinen tunnistautuminen' (admin) and 'kaksivaiheinen tunnistautuminen' (user settings); prefer 'monivaiheinen tunnistautuminen'.

Entra ID.note: Legacy login.office365 has 'Entra-tunnus' — do not follow.

Gossip.note: Protocol name; never render literally as 'juoru'.

Global Relay.note: Compound with a hyphen: 'Global Relay -palvelin', 'Global Relay EML -vienti'.

System Console.note: Established rendering (järjestelmäkonsoli, järjestelmäkonsoliin). Capitalize as a named UI area in menu labels.

marketplace.note: Plugin marketplace. Not in the existing catalog yet; 'lisäosien markkinapaikka' when context is needed.

channel.note: Plural 'kanavat'. The catalog uses both 'kanavalle/kanavalta' and 'kanavaan/kanavasta'; prefer the inner cases 'kanavaan', 'kanavassa', 'kanavasta' except in established 'Poistu kanavalta' / 'Kiinnitä kanavaan'.

team.note: Majority rendering (60 vs 40). The older strings use 'joukkue' (joukkueeseen, joukkueen) — do not reintroduce. Compounds: tiimin jäsenet, tiimin nimi.

post.note: Same as message; 'julkaisu' is not used.

thread.note: Plural 'ketjut'; the Threads view is 'Ketjut'. 'Viestiketju' is acceptable when a bare 'ketju' would be unclear. Never 'säie'.

reply.note: Noun: vastaus, plural vastaukset. Verb: vastata; button 'Vastaa'.

direct message.note: Established (17). Plural 'suoraviestit'. Keep the DM abbreviation as-is.

group message.note: Plural 'ryhmäviestit'. Keep the GM abbreviation as-is.

mention.note: Noun: maininta, plural maininnat. Verb: mainita. '@mention' → '@-maininta'.

pin.note: Button 'Kiinnitä kanavaan'; pinned = 'Kiinnitetty', pinned messages = 'Kiinnitetyt viestit'; unpin = 'Poista kiinnitys'.

bookmark.note: Plural 'kirjanmerkit' (established in server catalog). Verb: 'Lisää kirjanmerkki'.

emoji.note: Established (99 vs 2 'hymiö'). Plural 'emojit'; do not use 'hymiö'.

custom emoji.note: Plural 'mukautetut emojit'. The catalog also has 'Omat Emojit' in admin strings; prefer 'mukautettu emoji' (matches emoji_picker.custom 'Mukautettu').

away.note: Established status label (modal.manual_status.title_away). Lowercase 'poissa' in sentences.

online.note: Use for the availability status; in prose 'verkossa' is acceptable.

offline.note: Loanword used in Finnish UIs and in the existing catalog ('kun olet offline'). Legacy 'Ei-verkkotilassa' (modal.manual_status) is awkward — do not follow. Compound: 'offline-tila'.

guest.note: Plural 'vieraat'. Guest access = vieraskäyttö; guest account = vierastili.

member.note: Plural 'jäsenet'. Compounds: kanavan jäsenet, tiimin jäsenet.

team admin.note: Catalog mixes 'tiimin valvoja' and 'joukkueen järjestelmänvalvoja'; prefer 'tiimin ylläpitäjä' so it is distinct from 'järjestelmänvalvoja'.

sign in.note: Button 'Kirjaudu sisään'; noun 'kirjautuminen'. Translate 'sign in' and 'log in' identically.

sign out.note: Button 'Kirjaudu ulos'. Translate 'sign out' and 'log out' identically.

favorite.note: Plural 'suosikit'; sidebar category 'Suosikit'. Verb: 'Lisää suosikkeihin'; unfavorite: 'Poista suosikeista' (established).

search.note: Noun 'haku'; verb 'hakea'. The search button/label is 'Etsi' in the existing catalog (channel_header.search, accessibility); keep 'Etsi' for buttons, 'Hae' is also acceptable.

webhook.note: Kept in English (115 occurrences); 'web-koukku' appears once — do not follow. Inflect: webhookin, webhookit. Compound with a hyphen: webhook-URL.

scheme.note: Permission scheme = 'käyttöoikeusmalli', team override scheme = 'tiimin ohitusmalli'. The catalog mixes 'kaava', 'järjestely', 'suunnitelma' and 'malli'; prefer 'malli'.

sidebar.note: Established. The right-hand side panel may be 'oikea sivupaneeli'.

attachment.note: Plural 'liitteet'. 'liitetiedosto' is fine in prose when the attachment is a file.

channel header.note: Established in edit_channel_header_modal. Bare 'header' = otsikko. Do not use 'ylätunniste' (appears in a few accessibility strings).

recap.note: AI-generated activity recap. Plural 'koosteet'. Use 'yhteenveto' for the generic 'summary'.

agent.note: AI assistant. Plural 'agentit'; 'AI agent' = 'tekoälyagentti'. The product name 'Agents' stays English.

burn-on-read.note: Adjective; the message label is 'TUHOUTUU LUETTAESSA' and the message type 'luettaessa tuhoutuva viesti'.

personal access token.note: Plural 'henkilökohtaiset käyttöoikeustunnukset'. One legacy string has 'access token' in English — do not follow. Bare 'token' = tunnus.

collapsed reply threads.note: Feature name; not in the existing catalog yet. 'vastausketju' is used for reply threads in notification settings.

data retention.note: Policy = 'tietojen säilytyskäytäntö' (legacy has the solid compound 'tietojensäilytyskäytäntö'; either is acceptable, prefer the two-word form).

compliance export.note: The one legacy string has 'compliance-vienti'; prefer the Finnish term. 'Compliance' alone = vaatimustenmukaisuus.

access control.note: Attribute-based access control = 'attribuuttipohjainen pääsynhallinta'; policy = käytäntö.

attribute.note: Established in LDAP strings. Plural 'attribuutit'. Custom profile attribute = 'mukautettu profiiliattribuutti'.

onboarding.note: Not in the existing catalog yet; 'käyttöönotto' only for server/admin setup contexts.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n (api.channel.create_default_channels.town_square). Legacy webapp string has lowercase 'town-square' — do not follow.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n (api.channel.create_default_channels.off_topic).

read-only.note: Adjective form 'vain luku -tilassa oleva kanava' or 'kirjoitussuojattu kanava'; prefer 'vain luku -kanava'.
